items.name: Maiden

items.name: Lover

items.name: Crone
items.keyQualities: Truth beyond approval, reverence for cycles, and service free of the need to be central.

items.name: Reckless Wanderer
items.keyQualities: Motion warrants itself, Urgency becomes a promise, Spends without consent, Breaks promises for novelty, Plans after fallout, Transfers risk to others

items.name: Sheltered Dreamer
items.keyQualities: Endless safety research, Demands certainty to begin, Magnifies remote dangers, Borrows courage from others, Waits to feel fully ready, Calls avoidance prudence

items.name: Naive Enthusiast
items.keyQualities: Trusts first impressions, Agrees before clear terms, Invents unproven virtues, Calls resonance evidence, Dismisses sober warnings, Recruits others too soon

items.name: Frozen Beginner
items.keyQualities: Evaluates, never tries, Makes choices permanent, Needs skill before practice, Outsources first attempts, Protects untested potential, Calls curiosity frivolous

items.name: Inflated Oracle
items.keyQualities: Makes impressions facts, Treats intensity as proof, Confuses sight with meaning, Makes dissent confirm it, Claims others' motives, Keeps claims unfalsifiable

items.name: Self-Doubting Seer
items.keyQualities: Rejects untested impressions, Privileges others' dismissal, Demands proof to speak, Defers sight to experts, Explains away body signals, Waits for consensus

items.name: Compulsive Perfecter
items.keyQualities: Moves the finish line, Revises to delay exposure, Controls against discovery, Polishes trivial details, Edits out distinctive voice, Calls feedback rejection

items.name: Scattered Maker
items.keyQualities: Starts, never continues, Switches at normal friction, Lets mood gatekeep work, Broadcasts raw impulses, Changes shared scope alone, Avoids every finish

items.name: Enmeshing Lover
items.keyQualities: Rushes intimacy for safety, Monitors mood, hides needs, Turns service into debt, Uses crisis for closeness, Reads distance as refusal, Shrinks life to one bond

items.name: Armored Lover
items.keyQualities: Intellectualizes feeling, Performs tenderness, Hides need behind praise, Leaves before need is seen, Treats help as lost rank, Keeps one self unreachable

items.name: Rescuing Healer
items.keyQualities: Turns pain into her mandate, Intervenes before consent, Turns requests into missions, Owns another's outcome, Promises beyond capacity, Crosses role limits

items.name: Guarded Healer
items.keyQualities: Expects an invoice in need, Uses rules to avoid contact, Analyzes instead of caring, Fears finite care, Generalizes one danger, Calls non-rescue non-care

items.name: Controlling Sentinel
items.keyQualities: Polices ordinary choices, Treats novelty as danger, Moves boundaries alone, Demands one-way access, Ignores proven capacity, Cannot stand down

items.name: Open Gate
items.keyQualities: Ignores repeated breaches, Calls sincerity safe, Restores trust unchanged, Calls access inclusion, Makes others carry risk, Keeps no response plan

items.name: Engulfing Mother
items.keyQualities: Anticipates every need, Solves before being asked, Makes separation betrayal, Uses worry as authority, Undermines growing skill, Makes sacrifice an invoice

items.name: Unavailable Mother
items.keyQualities: Minimizes ordinary need, Withdraws during distress, Calls neglect freedom, Delegates without a handoff, Shames dependency, Returns only after crisis

items.name: Peace Enforcer
items.keyQualities: Mutes truth with calm, Dilutes unequal harm, Puts intent over impact, Makes anger the new offense, Rushes reunion, Protects insiders from costs

items.name: Resentful Bystander
items.keyQualities: Keeps private grievance logs, Expects mind-reading, Uses distance to punish, Rehearses imagined trials, Lets silence mimic peace, Makes repair feel surrender

items.name: Rampaging Warrior
items.keyQualities: Broadens the target, Calls criticism betrayal, Makes escalation self-proof, Moves the stopping condition, Punishes after safety, Dehumanizes to mute cost

items.name: Disarmed Warrior
items.keyQualities: Waits for airtight proof, Softens every firm limit, Calls anger proof of guilt, Turns anger against herself, Resists only indirectly, Calls inhibition restraint

items.name: Enmeshing Networker
items.keyQualities: Trades closeness for status, Circulates confidences, Shields insiders from repair, Makes herself the hub, Makes departure costly, Sets ties on her terms

items.name: Isolated Helper
items.keyQualities: Works instead of belonging, Gives labor, hides need, Judges from the margins, Leaves at normal conflict, Refuses mutual support, Uses critique to avoid stake

items.name: Martyr Host
items.keyQualities: Monitors all but herself, Makes welcome cost service, Hides needs until resentful, Tallies unasked sacrifice, Calls rest selfish, Erases herself as host

items.name: Closed Hearth
items.keyQualities: Calls people intrusions, Makes welcome conditional, Keeps sanctuary unusable, Uses home to avoid contact, Withholds basic comfort, Turns privacy into exclusion

items.name: Merciless Judge
items.keyQualities: Fixes identity to one act, Calls context an excuse, Punishes past protection, Turns exposure into theater, Uses blame to prove rigor, Closes paths to repair

items.name: Permissive Witness
items.keyQualities: Explains harm away, Centers intent over impact, Shields actors from results, Forgives unchanged conduct, Values ties over safety, Lets mercy erase the harmed

items.name: Tyrannical Queen
items.keyQualities: Centralizes decisions, Calls dissent disloyal, Rewards proximity over truth, Makes herself essential, Calls obedience alignment, Uses order to serve ego

items.name: Abdicating Queen
items.keyQualities: Delays role-bound decisions, Accommodates without end, Uses consensus as cover, Apologizes for authority, Lets informal power rule, Puts herself last by reflex

items.name: Blinding Star
items.keyQualities: Pulls attention to herself, Turns visibility into rank, Calls admiration agreement, Occupies every spotlight, Uses others as mirrors, Competes with new voices

items.name: Hidden Light
items.keyQualities: Hides visible expertise, Declines earned notice, Calls visibility vanity, Yields to weaker voices, Shrinks impact to avoid envy, Uses humility to disappear

items.name: Manipulative Sorceress
items.keyQualities: Claims ability as mandate, Leverages without consent, Hides costs and tradeoffs, Defines others' benefit, Calls resistance ignorance, Calls compliance success

items.name: Powerless Mystic
items.keyQualities: Requires certainty to act, Calls limited scope none, Reviews without deciding, Demands zero-risk action, Uses risk as excuse, Calls withdrawal integrity

items.name: Scorched-Earth Crone
items.keyQualities: Chooses severance first, Erases a mixed past, Destroys needed supports, Calls reflection weakness, Ends bonds to avoid grief, Leaves nothing to compost

items.name: Relic Keeper
items.keyQualities: Keeps roles past use, Calls release erasure, Builds identity around loss, Keeps duties past use, Calls new bonds betrayal, Freezes the past in place

items.name: Martyred Healer
items.keyQualities: Answers every pain, Stays beyond useful witness, Makes love endless duty, Claims others' outcomes, Refuses limits and endings, Spends health to keep watch

items.name: Cynical Healer
items.keyQualities: Predicts failure at arrival, Turns patterns into verdicts, Uses realism as armor, Listens only for futility, Withholds care without cure, Calls numbness wisdom

items.name: Premature Oracle
items.keyQualities: Speaks before trust, Predicts, does not receive, Overloads present choices, Calls unreadiness resistance, Mystifies her authority, Makes vision create urgency

items.name: Withholding Seer
items.keyQualities: Delays clear speech, Waits until all can see it, Hides guidance in riddles, Calls silence wisdom, Avoids early exposure, Misses the useful moment

items.name: Chaotic Rebel
items.keyQualities: Opposes limits by reflex, Purges imperfect allies, Escalates without strategy, Makes disruption the goal, Exports rupture's costs, Destroys without rebuilding

items.name: Compliant Critic
items.keyQualities: Dissents only in safety, Obeys publicly, rebels alone, Waits for spotless action, Analyzes, never acts, Lets power define choices, Uses critique to stay pure

items.name: Arrogant Know-It-All
items.keyQualities: Declares conclusions final, Answers before inquiry, Treats dissent as ignorance, Advises beyond her scope, Uses speed to guard status, Doubles down on error

items.name: Withholding Sage
items.keyQualities: Waits for impossible proof, Turns inquiry into delay, Defers to loud authority, Qualifies counsel away, Resents choices she ceded, Calls self-erasure humility

items.name: Exaggerating Dramatist
items.keyQualities: Invents in memory gaps, Reports inference as fact, Erases doubt for drama, Recenters entrusted stories, Shares without consent, Chooses effect over accuracy

items.name: Silent Keeper
items.keyQualities: Demands total certainty, Calls selection betrayal, Archives, never transmits, Lets privacy forbid telling, Keeps context too long, Lets memory vanish unused
